payload.name: VPS operations
payload.scope: Evidence-aware VPS host, container, shared-volume, native gateway operations and bounded Hermes backend-only or native Desktop/backend version promotion. Infrastructure only; ministry and academy business effects, unsolicited credential changes, and automatic broad restarts or deletion are excluded.

commands.check: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked

ontologyPin.implementation: owned typed Rust domain; frozen JSON schema and registry

verificationBoundary: Configured topology and observed ownership are distinct.
Current process incarnation and exact-inode evidence precede lifecycle effects.
Frontend reachability does not prove native gateway serving.
Verification and acceptance are separate records.
Runtime shape validation does not establish authority, evidence truth, or freshness.
details.nativeLifecycle: Use the installed native lifecycle; preserve active sessions and unrelated services.
